messages.text: We agree on this funded Raid. I accept the combat opportunity because your Spear is offered, our trade should complete safely, and civilian relief has an identified ship. I will judge this month's result separately from any demand for permanent military freedom.

Your lodged reserve and written Relief directive answer my immediate concern. Proceed with the proposed Raid and Warrant. After resolution, my priority is an explicit repair plan: the reserve cannot pay these costs again, and Beacon one is not an acceptable permanent settlement.

reason: The specific written coordination is stronger evidence than a protection promise alone. I retain my support for this operation while reserving judgment on which constitutional powers should follow from it.
